leitura.texto:
Choosing a new forklift
Our warehouse needs a new forklift, and we compared three models. The Lift 200 is the cheapest: it costs R$ 90,000. However, it is the oldest design and it uses diesel, so it is noisier and more expensive to maintain. The Lift 300 costs R$ 120,000. It is electric, so it is quieter and cleaner than the Lift 200, and the maintenance is much cheaper. The Lift 400 is the most expensive (R$ 150,000) and the most modern. It is a little faster than the 300, but it isn't as easy to repair, because the parts come from Japan. Our recommendation is the Lift 300: it isn't the cheapest, but it is the best option for our budget in the long term.

perguntas.enunciado: What are the advantages of the Lift 300 over the 200?
Which one is the most modern?
Why is the Lift 400 not as easy to repair?

opcoes: It's the best option for the budget in the long term.

falas.en: I'm choosing a new phone. Can you help me?
falas.pt: Estou escolhendo um celular novo. Pode me ajudar?

falas.en: The X5 and the Z10. The X5 is cheaper, but the Z10 has a better camera.
falas.pt: O X5 e o Z10. O X5 é mais barato, mas o Z10 tem uma câmera melhor.

falas.en: The battery is the same. Both last two days.
falas.pt: A bateria é igual. As duas duram dois dias.

falas.en: Is the X5 as fast as the Z10?
falas.pt: O X5 é tão rápido quanto o Z10?

falas.en: No, it isn't as fast. But I only use it for messages and photos.
falas.pt: Não, não é tão rápido. Mas eu só uso para mensagens e fotos.

falas.en: Photos? Then the Z10 is the best choice for you!
falas.pt: Fotos? Então o Z10 é a melhor escolha para você!

perguntas.enunciado: Which phone has a better camera?
How long do the batteries last?
Is the X5 as fast as the Z10?
What does Ana use her phone for?

foco_avaliacao: Nível A2. Comparativos de adjetivos curtos (-er, -ier, dobrar consoante) e longos (more/less), irregulares (better, worse), superlativos (the -est, the most, the least, the best, the worst), as…as / not as…as, the same as, different from, recomendar uma opção.
